title: All Together Now
supportedClaims: The book's strongest money advice only makes full sense when humility, patience, savings, enough, and independence are treated as one coherent temperament.
Each rule strengthens the others: room for error protects patience, enough protects judgment, savings protect freedom, and humility keeps all of it realistic.
The practical task is to build a plan you can survive, explain, and repeat rather than chase an idealized plan that fails at the first serious shock.
caution: A summary chapter is especially vulnerable to sloganizing, so its force depends on whether the reader keeps the tensions from the earlier chapters alive.
